poor.quote: I have no Plan B other than continuing my studies at Cisame
Yet walking away from Cisame was something Theodore could no longer afford.
completely unaffordable for a subseraphian or a soul from the Ground
And if you stayed at Cisame, you might never even have to pay interest on the endlessly compounding debt. Because in Seraph, absolutely nothing came for free.
by the fourth, however, any hope of paying off debts was out the window
uncovering the mysteries of the Plans, poetry, or metaphysically treading
Sift through the scrap scavenged from Shards by the Gathers
Agness waited for an expository pause

good.quote: allowing one to live in Seraph in ever-greater style—and pay ever-steeper tuition fees
After all, someone had to repair the megabarges. Torture demons.
Find treasures—or at least LED bulbs.
Carve hearts from corpses for healing potions…
letting Theodore marinate in the unenviable prospects
